subject: Don't let install flags affect build (#382)
reason: Build-system change with no reachable behavior difference. The Makefile stops passing -DUSE_REDIS_SYMLINKS, and server.c makes the argv[0] dispatch to redis_check_rdb_main/redis_check_aof_main unconditional. Because the Makefile default is USE_REDIS_SYMLINKS?=yes, both the parent and the change builds used by the fuzzer compile that dispatch in already, so they behave identically for every invocation the fuzzer can make.
